summary: A regular who expected an election-day shift feels slighted and stays home.
realLife: Peters described being left off a faction’s work list as a blow to a regular’s pride.
gates: A returning worker expected a place on the roster.
inGame: Campaigns records volunteer membership and evenings of doors. needs: a named election-day roster and an omitted assignment.

turns.what: The regular calls the desk and gets the familiar shift back.
turns.pulledBy: The organizer left a name off while copying the roster.
turns.writesBack: The corrected list names the regular.

turns.what: The regular takes a short relief shift when a neighbor asks.
turns.pulledBy: A full shift is already assigned and the neighbor needs a break.
turns.writesBack: The relief stint appears separately on the roster.
